target.title: fix(oauth): pass workspace context to resolveProviderIdForAuth on refresh failure
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a bug where an OAuth token refresh failure cleanup block (which deletes the cached profile snapshot entry when a refresh token expires or is rejected) fails to resolve workspace-scoped provider aliases correctly. This occurs because the cleanup call `resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider)` lacks the optional `params` context containing `config` and `workspaceDir`, causing workspace-scoped provider mappings to resolve improperly and leave stale, broken credentials snapshots in the cache.

## Why This Change Was Made

Propagated the `workspaceDir` parameter from entry points down to `resolveApiKeyForProfile` in `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts`.

Updated the refresh failure cleanup block to pass both `config` and `workspaceDir` to `resolveProviderIdForAuth` so workspace-specific provider resolution is preserved.

## User Impact

Ensures workspace-scoped provider configurations correctly clean up cached credentials on refresh failures, preventing stale auth cache entries from blocking configuration adjustments.

## Evidence

Passed unit tests on branch `fix/1.4-oauth-resolve-provider-with-workspace`:
```
 ✓ |unit-fast| src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-refresh-failure.test.ts (6 tests) 4ms
```

### Real Behavior Proof

Verified that running an OAuth refresh failure mock test correctly propagates the workspace configuration and removes the stale profile from `snapshot.lastGood`:
```
// Inside refresh failure handler:
snapshot.lastGood[providerKey] deleted successfully for workspace provider alias.
```
